profiles.name: awo-reviewer
profiles.when: An independent correctness/security review is valuable after a substantive change.
profiles.not_when: A microtask, exploration only, or hard read-only filesystem enforcement is required.
profiles.brief: Goal, changed files, acceptance criteria, relevant tests, constraints and explicit no-edit scope.
profiles.output: Prioritized actionable findings with file:line evidence, impact, test gaps and uncertainties. Say no findings when appropriate.
profiles.verification: Parent reproduces material findings, integrates fixes and runs appropriate checks before acceptance.
profiles.ownership: No file ownership or edits. Do not run commands that mutate files; request parent-run checks if needed. This is behavioral guidance, not a read-only sandbox.

profiles.name: awo-evidence
profiles.when: A complex handoff needs an independent audit of claims against logs, diffs and acceptance criteria.
profiles.not_when: Ordinary coding or code review is sufficient, evidence is unavailable, or isolated filesystem access is required.
profiles.brief: Acceptance criteria, exact evidence paths, changed scopes, known limitations and claims to check.
profiles.output: Claim-to-evidence table; distinguish observed, inferred, OFFLINE-TESTED, DESIGN-ONLY, UNSUPPORTED and NOT VERIFIED. Identify stale or missing checks.
profiles.verification: Parent verifies actual files and command outcomes. Never manufacture receipts or mark an integration verified from a report alone.
profiles.ownership: Read-heavy audit, no edits or nested agents. Parent retains integration ownership; inherited tools and permissions are not narrowed by this prompt.
